statement_en: Let $\mu^{*}:\mathcal{P}(X)\to [0,\infty]$ be an outer measure on $X$, and let $\mathcal{F}$ be the family of all subsets of $X$ that are $\mu^{*}$-measurable in the Caratheodory sense. Define $\mu:\mathcal{F}\to [0,+\infty]$ by restricting the outer measure, namely $\mu(E)=\mu^{*}(E)$ for all $E\in\mathcal{F}$. Then $\mathcal{F}$ is a $\sigma$-algebra, $\mu$ is a measure on $\mathcal{F}$, and $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ is a measure space.
